headline: Adds a category-based vendor panel and improved window layering to BetterBags Next.

entries.title: Vendor replacement panel in BetterBags Next
entries.details: When BetterBags Next is enabled, visiting a merchant opens a panel organized into your backpack categories, featuring Buy, Buyback, and Repair tabs. It includes a dedicated search bar, quick repair and junk selling buttons, Masque skinning, and allows selling items individually or by dragging an entire category section directly onto the vendor.

entries.title: Side panel layering in BetterBags Next
entries.details: Side panels now render above standard interface elements while remaining safely beneath confirmation popups, dropdown menus, and tooltips.
